stem: A plant develops a visual symptom that resembles a mineral deficiency. Which diagnostic approach is strongest?
choices: Evaluate nutrient supply together with developmental stage, root-zone conditions and interacting nutrients before assigning a cause
Identify the cause from leaf color alone
Assume the nutrient with the lowest label percentage is deficient
Increase every fertilizer component at the same time
rationale: Mineral nutrition responses are interactive and context-dependent, so a single visual symptom or nutrient concentration is insufficient for a defensible diagnosis.
